Summer Maxwell / Bloomberg :

 Arianespace's Ariane 6 rocket launches 36 Amazon Leo satellites from ESA's spaceport in French Guiana, its fourth Amazon mission and the rocket's 10th flight   —  A European rocket blasted off Tuesday carrying 36 satellites for Amazon.com Inc.'s orbital communications network …
